data.name: Sharvikman
data.long_meaning: Sharvikman is a compound name derived from Sanskrit words 'Sharva' and 'Kman'. Sharva is a name of Lord Shiva, the god of power, destruction, and regeneration. Kman means 'man', 'being', or 'person'. Together, Sharvikman can be interpreted as 'god of power and victory', 'powerful being', or 'victorious person'.
